name: Generic UDS coding templates
author: bod3
description: Starting points for your own recipes. Copy one with Edit, change the module, identifier and positions to match your module's documentation, then save it as your own recipe.

recipes.name: Long-coding bit (template)
recipes.description: Switch one bit of a module's coding (identifier 0600).
recipes.notes: Replace the module, byte and mask before use.

recipes.name: Adaptation channel value (template)
recipes.description: A 2-byte numeric adaptation value, shown scaled.
recipes.notes: Identifier 0100 is a placeholder; use the adaptation channel identifier from your module's documentation.

recipes.name: Identifier option (template)
recipes.description: Choose one of a few named values stored in an identifier byte.
